# skill: marketplace-product-images

Use when product photos go on Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop

# marketplace-product-images — product images for Shopee · Lazada · TikTok Shop

> **Gate before starting (every time):** read the owner's theme → search live references → 3 genuinely different directions → check `no-ai-look` before sending · follow the "ด่านก่อนลงมือ" (pre-start gate) section of `design-references` (plugin `superuser`), even when a brand exists (the brand sets colours and fonts, and the search is for the structure of this piece) · close the work with the line `ด่านก่อนลงมือ:`

Part of plugin `graphic-design` · wording follows `human-writing` · the owner is agent `social-creator` · text on the product page (name · description · banned ad claims) lives in `e-commerce:product-listing`

> **One rule:** the cover image must show one real product, fully visible, on a plain background, with no contact channel and no other platform's logo (the individual bans are still `รอยืนยัน` (awaiting confirmation), see the table). Make 1 set at 1:1, 1000 × 1000 or larger (a value we chose to sit above the minimum once seen), then compare it with each platform's live minimum. Before uploading a big batch, open the official pages again.

## Use when

- Shooting or editing product photos to list in a shop on Shopee · Lazada · TikTok Shop
- An image was rejected, a product was suspended, or penalty points were given because of an image
- Making a cover image, a product option image (colour · size), a size chart or an image in the description

## Do not use when (use another skill instead or alongside)

| Task | Use |
|---|---|
| Product name, description, words banned in ads | `e-commerce:product-listing` (if installed) |
| Shop banner, ad post, video clip | `social-formats` · `campaign-set` · `video-script-to-clip` |
| Generating a product image with AI or changing the background | `brief-to-image` · `image-editing-brief` · it must still be the real product the customer will receive |
| Several images that must look like one set | `style-consistency` |
| Labels, boxes, stickers sent to a printer | `print-ready-files` |

## Steps

1. **Shoot once, use on every platform:** the full product, straight-on angle, even light, white or plain-colour background · export 1:1 at 1000 × 1000 up to 1600 × 1600 · JPG, with a file size under the ceiling read live from the official page.
2. **Cover image (the first image):** a single product fills most of the frame (TikTok Shop has a minimum share for the product, check live) · do not zoom so far that the product edge is cut · no frame around the 4 sides · as little text and as few stickers as possible, and never covering the product.
3. **Images after the cover (no more than the platform allows):** other angles · material detail · size against a hand or a familiar object · size chart (clothing) · in-use image · each colour option image must match the colour actually shipped.
4. **Check the banned items** (the ban table) on every image, not only the cover.
5. **Name the files** per `asset-organize`, for example `mug-white-shopee-cover-v01.jpg` · keep 1 set of original files with no text added.

## Image size and count per platform

Marketplace image rules change often, so no figures are kept here. What stays fixed is the main 1:1 ratio and a single set of images shot once and usable on every platform.

What to look up for each of Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada: minimum and maximum image size · ratio rules (including Shopee 3:4 and what the promotion slot shows) · number of images per listing · file size and format · cover background and how much of the frame the product must fill · video limits (file size, length, dimensions). Official sources are in the sources section below. Lazada has no openable official page, so mark every Lazada value (รอยืนยัน) unless you find one.

Look up live (WebSearch/WebFetch) before using it; if the page will not open, mark the value (รอยืนยัน).

## What is banned on images

| Ban | Platforms whose official page states it | Result if broken |
|---|---|---|
| Contact channels: phone number · LINE · page · email · QR code · link to another sales channel | Shopee · TikTok Shop | Shopee gives penalty points |
| A badge or symbol that imitates the platform's (for example Shopee's own badge) · a generic badge such as "free shipping" is fine | Shopee | Shopee suspends the product every Friday until it is fixed |
| An image that is not the real product, or edited until it differs from what is shipped | Shopee · TikTok Shop · Lazada (product quality policy) | The product is removed · customers return the goods |
| Using another shop's image, or removing someone else's watermark | Shopee | The product is removed |
| A sticker or watermark covering the product | TikTok Shop | Fails review |
| Nudity, obscene, violent or frightening images | Shopee (no appeal) · TikTok Shop | The product is removed |
| Using someone else's brand or logo without permission | TikTok Shop | The product is removed |
| Another platform's logo on the image | Seen only in search results, official page not yet read | (รอยืนยัน) |

Every row in this table comes from the platform's official page, but there are not yet 2 independent sources besides, so it still counts as (รอยืนยัน) under the 3-source rule. No rule about "text over X%", "no price on the image" or "no collage of several images" was found on the official pages of all 3 platforms. Do not tell the user these rules exist.

## Worked example

Task: a shop selling handmade ceramic mugs, listing on all 3 platforms, with 3 colours

| Step | Do | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Shoot | Shoot on white paper in window light, crop to 1:1 at 1200 × 1200 | 1 set usable on every platform |
| Cover | One white mug, fully visible, filling most of the frame · no text | Meets TikTok Shop's product-share condition and Shopee's advice (compared with the live official page) |
| Images after the cover | Close-up of the handle · held in a hand · 3 colours side by side · a size image with a ruler · in use on a table | Removed the LINE QR code the shop had put in a corner of the image |

## Check before handing over

- [ ] Every image is 1:1, at least 1000 × 1000, and the file is under the platform's live ceiling
- [ ] The cover is one real product, fully visible, on a plain background, with no frame and with text that does not cover the product
- [ ] No phone number, LINE, QR, link or other platform's logo in any image
- [ ] Colours in the option images match what is really shipped · an image made or edited with AI still shows the same single product that is sold
- [ ] Tell the user which values are still (รอยืนยัน), and to look at the platform's upload page before listing a big batch

## Sources (marketplace image rules change often · open them live every time you use them)

- Shopee Seller Education Hub (official · opened and read): [14587 product images](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/14587) · [6985 media library](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/6985) · [17297 3:4 images](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/17297) · [10040 imitation badges](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/10040) · [7052 product policy](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/7052) · [26814](https://seller.shopee.co.th/edu/article/26814)
- TikTok Shop Seller University Thailand (official · opened and read): [product image rules](https://seller-th.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=7066060516738833&lang=en) · [product policy](https://seller-th.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=6837810275518210&lang=en) · [image upload API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/upload-product-image) (read from search results) · other guides: soona.co · riverflow.ai
- Lazada: no openable official page found (Seller Center needs a login · community.lazada.co.th article 1376800 is seen only in search results) · other guides: [ChannelEngine](https://support.channelengine.com/hc/en-us/articles/4409485398685) · jtexpress.sg

# skill: speaking-script

Use when writing a script for a person speaking on camera

# Speaking Script

> **One rule of this skill:** write for the ear, not the eye — every line must survive being read aloud. The script is done when someone who did not write it can read it aloud once and sound like a person, not a document.

This skill lives in plugin `graphic-design` · the wording of the script follows `human-writing` (plugin `superuser`), except where this file says otherwise, because spoken language has its own rules · a finished script goes on to filming or video generation with `video-script-to-clip` (shot list · captions · safe zones are there)

## When to use

- Clips where a person speaking to the camera is the main thing — review · storytelling · teaching · opinion · vlog · YouTube · spoken TikTok/ Reel · event host · voiceover for a clip
- Fixing a spoken script that reads like an article

## When **not** to use

| Task | Use |
|---|---|
| Short ad clip led by the picture (product · demo · understandable with sound off) | `video-script-to-clip` |
| Minute-by-minute live selling | `live-selling-script` |
| Subtitles · on-screen text · safe zone | `video-script-to-clip` section caption rules |
| Speech for a meeting/stage presentation with slides | `presentation-design` + speaker notes |
| Make audio from a script without recording it yourself (text-to-speech) | `narration-th` · write the script here first, then pass it on |

---

## Workflow

0. **Watch what works first** — do this when the niche or format is new and no proven script of the series exists: find 3–5 clips in the same niche and format that perform (views/comments relative to the account size), write 1 line per clip on *why people keep watching* (the hook sentence · how fast the point starts · what keeps it open) · save links beside the script file · **these are a bar to clear, not a script to copy** — same lesson as `brief-to-image` step 0
1. **One takeaway, one audience, one action** — sentence 1: who is the viewer, and what do you want them to know, feel or do when the clip ends · if you cannot write it in 1 sentence, it is 2 clips
2. **Write the hook as the first spoken sentence** — patterns below · no "สวัสดีครับ วันนี้จะมา…" (Hello, today I will…) — the hook must carry the reason to stay
3. **Beat sheet** — hook → setup (why listen · 1–2 sentences) → beats with 1 idea each → payoff (answers what the hook promised) → a single call to action · a 30–60 second clip needs only 3–5 beats
4. **Write spoken Thai** — rules below · read every line aloud as you write it
5. **Time it with a stopwatch, not a word count** — read the whole script aloud once at show pace and time it · over time → cut the last beat first · everyone speaks at a different speed, so do not use someone else's words-per-minute figure
6. **Add delivery cues sparingly** — `[หยุด]` (pause) only where silence has an effect · `[เน้น]` (stress) only on the word whose sentence changes meaning if it is not stressed · put pictures/B-roll as a note beside the line, not written as a scene (scenes are the job of `video-script-to-clip`)
7. **Read-aloud pass by someone who did not write it** (or record yourself and listen) — a spot where you stumble is a spot to rewrite, not a spot where "it will be fine when I really say it"

## Hook patterns (first spoken sentence)

| Pattern | Example |
|---|---|
| Go against a popular idea | "ทุกคนบอกให้ลงคลิปทุกวัน ผมหยุดลงไป 2 สัปดาห์แล้วยอดดูขึ้น" |
| Confession | "ผมเคยเสียเงิน 30,000 กับคอร์สที่สอนสิ่งที่เดี๋ยวบอกฟรีในคลิปนี้" |
| A number that looks odd | "ร้านนี้ขายกาแฟแก้วละ 45 แต่คนต่อคิว 40 นาที" |
| A question the viewer is already asking | "เคยไหม ซื้อของออนไลน์แล้วได้ของไม่ตรงปก คืนก็ไม่ได้" |
| Promise a payoff | "ฟังจบคลิปนี้ เขียนสคริปต์พูดของตัวเองได้ใน 10 นาที" |
| Start in the middle of the event | "ตอนนั้นผมยืนอยู่หน้าร้าน มือถือกุมใบเสร็จ แล้วรู้ว่าโดนแล้ว" |

Rules: no greeting to open the clip · no introducing yourself before the hook · the hook must make the viewer ask "so what happens next?" — if the viewer has no open question after the first sentence, the hook has not passed

## Retention — keep them to the end

- **Open 1 loop** — say at the start what is waiting at the end of the clip ("สาเหตุที่แท้ เดี๋ยวบอกตอนจบ") · do not open more than 1 loop in a short clip
- **Signposts** — "จุดแรก…" "สำคัญสุดคือจุดถัดไป" the listener must always know where they are
- **Break the rhythm** — change the angle every 2–3 beats (from story, to a question, to a number)
- **The answer the hook promised must really arrive at the payoff** — a hook that does not pay out is clickbait, and viewers remember it and do not come back

## Spoken Thai — rules that differ from written language

| Before (written language) | After (spoken language) |
|---|---|
| เนื่องจากราคาสูงเกินไป ลูกค้าจึงไม่ซื้อ | แพงเกินไปครับ คนเลยไม่ซื้อ |
| วันนี้ผมจะมาอธิบายเกี่ยวกับ… | (cut it — go straight to the point) |
| ผลิตภัณฑ์นี้มีคุณสมบัติที่โดดเด่นคือ | ของชิ้นนี้ดีตรงที่… |
| ดังนั้น อย่างไรก็ตาม ทั้งนี้ | แล้ว · แต่ · ก็ (speech uses short connectors) |
| A long sentence with 3 stacked connectors | Split into short sentences, 1 point each |

- End with ครับ/ค่ะ consistently, matching the person (pick one style for the whole script — tie it to the brand in `brand-kit`, item Voice)
- **Do not cut function words until the line is curt** (rule 3 of `human-writing` applies to spoken scripts too) — cut descriptive sentences, not the connectors that make it understandable by ear
- Big numbers must be easy to say: "1,250,000 บาท" → write it in the script as "ล้านสองแสนห้า" — so the speaker does not have to convert it in their head mid-air
- Read every line aloud while you write — the eye cannot fix what the ear catches

## Real example — a 45-second coffee shop review clip

**Summary before writing:** viewer = people who work in the office area · by the end, they should know this shop is worth the queue · action = drop by and try it

```
HOOK    "กาแฟแก้วละ 120 บาท แต่คนยอมต่อคิว 40 นาที ผมเลยไปลองดูว่ามันดียังไง"
SETUP   "ร้านนี้เปิดมา 8 เดือน ไม่มีที่นั่ง ไม่มีป้ายใหญ่ มีแค่เคาน์เตอร์เล็ก ๆ" [หยุด]
BEAT 1  "จุดแรกที่ต่างจากร้านอื่นคือ เขาคั่วเมล็ดเองทุกสัปดาห์ กลิ่นแรงตั้งแต่หัวซอย"
BEAT 2  "แก้วนี้คือซิกเนเจอร์ ผมสัมผัสได้ถึงรสผลไม้ก่อนความขม [เน้น]ก่อนความขม ซึ่งหายาก"
BEAT 3  "จุดที่ควรรู้คือ คิวยาวจริงช่วง 8 โมงเช้า แนะนำไปหลัง 10 โมง"
PAYOFF  "คำตอบคือ คุ้มครับ ถ้าคุณเป็นแฟนกาแฟจริง แต่ถ้าแค่อยากได้คาเฟอีน เซเว่นหน้าปากซอยพอ"
CTA     "ใครไปแล้ว เมนูไหนดี คอมเมนต์บอกหน่อยครับ เดี๋ยวผมไปลองตาม"
```

Read aloud and timed at 43 seconds — pass · (example written by the team, not a script that was actually published)

## Check before sending

- [ ] The first sentence is a hook from the table, not a greeting
- [ ] Every line reads aloud without stumbling (someone who did not write it read it, or you recorded and listened)
- [ ] Timed for real and fits the second budget (write the measured time at the head of the script)
- [ ] At most 1 open loop, and the payoff pays out the answer the hook promised
- [ ] No written-language words (เนื่องจาก · ดังนั้น · อย่างไรก็ตาม · ทั้งนี้ · คุณสมบัติ — "because · therefore · however · in this regard · property")
- [ ] Numbers are written as spoken words, not Arabic numerals
- [ ] ครับ/ค่ะ and pronouns are the same throughout and match `brand-kit` if it exists
- [ ] Picture/B-roll notes are kept apart from spoken lines, not mixed

## Anti-patterns

- **Writing in paragraphs like an article** and having the person read it — the eye reads faster than the mouth speaks, so a script must be short lines broken at breathing points
- **A hook of "สวัสดีครับ วันนี้…"** — the viewer swipes away before sentence two
- **Counting words instead of timing** — speaking speed varies a lot, and a words-per-minute figure you did not measure yourself is an inference (ยังไม่ได้ตรวจ against the speaker's real voice)
- **3 open loops in a 30-second clip** — the viewer cannot remember what they are waiting for, so they wait for nothing
- **A script never read aloud before sending** — matches the rule `principle-prove-it-works`: "works" = someone read it aloud and it flowed, not "finished writing"
